<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <text x="29" y="229" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tipo de viaje</text>

    <text x="227" y="260" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Solo ida</text>

    <text x="242" y="529" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Vuelta</text>
  </g>

  <text x="29" y="570" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Pasajeros y cabina</text>
  <g>

    <polygon points="136,810 151,814 136,818 130,825 127,823 132,815 127,811 130,809" fill="#EA104C"/>

    <text x="139" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Vuelos</text>

  <!-- Trips -->
  <g>
    <rect x="224" y="808" width="16" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="228" y1="805" x2="228" y2="811" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="236" y1="805" x2="236" y2="811" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="813" x2="240" y2="813" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="232" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Mis viajes</text>

  <!-- Account -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="333" cy="811" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <text x="333" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>

</svg>
